items.title: Joseph "Red" Clark Interview, 1959-11-11
items.q: this fellow Pritchett. He set this band up... I introduced myself to him... He says, I want somebody like you that I can train to myself... So I went on there and set up those overtures

ctx.x: First job of any kind. Of any kind?

Well I'll tell you, they set this concert band up, this fellow Pritchett. He set this band up. Well I had been practicing a lot and I'd been pinch hitting around with little bands all around, you know, different bands and all. So Willie Wilson, he was leading the record band at that time. And I knew Willie when he first came here. I knew him when he first came. He and Johnny. Willie worked at Sherwood's Pharmacy, which used to be at Canal and Durgin Wall.
